brief_rationale: The trajectory safely managed the core episode: it screened for stroke/bleeding red flags, respected unclear documents, repeatedly prevented unsupervised antithrombotic changes, linked BP/BG monitoring to follow-up, and assigned concrete owners/timing. It also completed high-order work by reconciling reassuring current symptoms with concerning CTA/vascular findings and dynamically reprioritizing between emergency care, neurology confirmation, imaging logistics, and later respiratory follow-up. No responsibility-chain error or important non-chain defect is evident, and the family ultimately had an executable plan with clear urgent escalation criteria.
